d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Sauté the pepper and onion in oil for 5 minutes. Add the steak and garlic powder and cook until browned. Season with salt and pepper.

Slice the rolls in half as one slab. Put the bottoms in a 9x13 dish, add half the provolone, the steak mixture, then the remaining cheese and the tops.

Brush with butter mixed with Worcestershire. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes.
de: Shaved steak, peppers and onions baked on Hawaiian rolls.

n: Ham and Swiss Hawaiian Roll Sliders
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Slice the rolls as one slab and layer ham and Swiss inside.

Whisk the butter, mustard, Worcestershire, poppy seeds and onion. Pour over the rolls.

Cover with foil and bake 12 minutes, then uncover and bake 3-5 minutes more.
de: Classic party sliders with a buttery poppy seed glaze.

d:
Toss the chicken with the buffalo sauce and ranch. Use less buffalo sauce for kids.

Butter the bread. Build sandwiches with cheese, chicken, then more cheese.

Cook in a skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and melted.
de: Crispy sourdough with buffalo chicken and two cheeses.

d:
Cook the bacon until crisp, in the oven at 400°F or in a skillet.

Mash the avocado with mayo, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

Spread on toast and layer lettuce, tomato and bacon.
de: The summer classic with a creamy avocado spread.

i: 1 bag (24 oz) frozen breaded chicken tenders
d:
Bake the chicken tenders per the package. Heat the oven to 375°F.

Slice the rolls as one slab. Layer the bottoms with provolone, tenders, Alfredo and mozzarella. Add the tops.

Brush with butter mixed with garlic powder and Italian seasoning, sprinkle with parmesan, and bake 10 minutes.
de: Chicken parm sliders with garlic Alfredo instead of marinara.

i: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into strips
d:
Toss the chicken with oil, half the lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Cook in a hot skillet 6-8 minutes.

Squeeze the grated cucumber dry. Stir it into the yogurt with the remaining lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

Warm the pitas and fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomatoes, onion and feta.
de: Lemon-oregano chicken in warm pitas with cucumber yogurt sauce.

i: 1 lb deli roast beef, thinly sliced
d:
Simmer the broth, Worcestershire, soy sauce, onion powder and butter for 5 minutes.

Dip the roast beef in the jus for 1 minute to warm it.

Pile the beef on the rolls, top with Swiss, and broil 2 minutes. Serve with cups of jus.
de: Shaved roast beef and Swiss with a quick au jus for dipping.

d:
Mix the chicken, mayo, yogurt, grapes, celery, lemon juice and garlic powder. Season with salt and pepper.

Split the croissants and fill with lettuce and chicken salad.
de: Creamy chicken salad with grapes and celery on buttery croissants.

d:
Roll the beef into 8 loose balls. Mix mayo, mustard and relish for the sauce.

Heat the griddle very hot. Add a ball, top with a few onion slices, and smash it flat with a spatula. Season with salt and pepper.

Cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese, and cook 1 minute more. Stack two patties on each buttered, toasted bun with sauce and pickles.
de: Crispy-edged diner burgers on the Blackstone or a cast iron pan.

d:
Cook the onions in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat for 15 minutes, until golden.

Shape the beef into 4 thin oval patties, season with seasoned salt, and cook 3 minutes per side.

Build sandwiches with cheese, patty, onions and cheese. Butter the outside and griddle 3 minutes per side.
de: Burger patties with caramelized onions and Swiss on griddled rye.

d:
Spread pesto inside the bread. Layer turkey, mozzarella and spinach.

Butter the outsides. Cook in a panini press or a skillet weighted with a heavy pan, 3-4 minutes per side.
de: Turkey, mozzarella and pesto pressed until crispy.

d:
Toss the chicken with oil, spices, half the lemon juice and 1 tsp salt.

Roast at 425°F for 18-20 minutes, or grill. Slice.

Mix yogurt, garlic and the rest of the lemon juice. Wrap the chicken in flatbreads with lettuce, cucumber and sauce.
de: Warm-spiced chicken thighs with garlic yogurt sauce in wraps.

d:
Heat the meatballs in the oven or microwave. Cut each in half. Heat the oven to 350°F.

Slice the rolls as one slab. Put the bottoms in a 9x13, spread with Alfredo, add the meatball halves, and top with mozzarella.

Add the tops and brush with garlic butter and parsley. Bake 15 minutes.
de: Frozen meatballs baked in Hawaiian rolls with garlic Alfredo and mozzarella.

i: 1 can (8 oz) pineapple rings, drained and quartered
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Warm the chicken with the teriyaki sauce.

Layer the roll bottoms with Swiss, chicken and pineapple. Add the tops.

Brush with butter, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and bake covered for 12 minutes.
de: Sweet teriyaki chicken with pineapple and Swiss on Hawaiian rolls.

d:
Cover the eggs with water, bring to a boil, cover, and turn off the heat for 11 minutes. Cool in ice water and peel.

Chop the eggs and mix with mayo, mustard, celery, chives and paprika. Season with salt and pepper.

Serve on bread with lettuce.
de: Creamy egg salad on soft bread. Boil the eggs ahead to save time.

i: 2 cups frozen diced hash brown potatoes
salsa verde or sour cream for serving
d:
Brown the sausage and remove it. Crisp the potatoes in the drippings for 8-10 minutes.

Whisk the eggs with milk, salt and pepper, and scramble in the same pan.

Fill the tortillas with eggs, sausage, potatoes and cheese. Roll up and toast seam-side down in a skillet.
de: Sausage, eggs, potatoes and cheese. They freeze well.

d:
Bake the biscuits per the package. Bake the bacon on a sheet pan at 400°F for 15 minutes.

Fry or scramble the eggs in butter and season with salt and pepper.

Split the biscuits and fill with egg, bacon and cheese.
de: Flaky biscuits stacked with bacon, egg and cheddar.

d:
Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.

Add the broth, thyme and bay leaf. Simmer 10 minutes.

Add the noodles and cook 7 minutes. Stir in the chicken and parsley. Season with salt and pepper and remove the bay leaf.
de: The classic. Rotisserie chicken makes it weeknight fast.

n: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
d:
Melt the butter and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.

Slowly whisk in the broth. Add the rice and thyme. Simmer covered for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender.

Stir in the chicken and cream and heat through. Season with salt and pepper.
de: Panera-style creamy soup with a wild rice blend.

d:
Brown the beef with the onion and drain. Remove from the pot.

Melt the butter and cook the carrots and celery for 4 minutes. Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth.

Add the potatoes and simmer 12-15 minutes until tender. Stir in the milk, beef and cheese until melted, then the sour cream. Season with salt and pepper.
de: Ground beef, potatoes and a velvety cheddar broth.

d:
Brown the sausage with the onion. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.

Add the broth and Italian seasoning and bring to a boil. Add the tortellini and cook 5 minutes.

Stir in the cream, parmesan and spinach until wilted.
de: Italian sausage, cheese tortellini and spinach in a creamy, tomato-free broth.

d:
Bake the biscuits per the package.

Melt the butter and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes. Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth.

Add the potatoes and thyme and simmer 12 minutes. Add the peas, chicken and cream and heat through. Serve with the biscuits.
de: All the pot pie flavor, served with flaky biscuits for dunking.

d:
Cook the bacon until crisp. Add the onion and celery and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the flour.

Whisk in the broth, add the potatoes, and simmer 12-15 minutes.

Add the corn, ham and half and half and simmer 5 minutes. Top with cheddar.
de: A good way to use leftover ham.

i: 2 cans (15 oz) great northern beans, drained
tortilla chips and shredded cheese for topping
d:
Cook the onion in oil for 4 minutes.

Add the broth, beans, chiles, corn and taco seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes.

Stir in the chicken and cream cheese until smooth. Top with chips and cheese.
de: Taco soup without tomatoes: white beans, corn and cream cheese.

d:
Bring the broth, soy sauce and ginger to a simmer.

Whisk the cornstarch with the water and stir it in. Simmer 2 minutes until slightly thickened.

Slowly drizzle in the eggs while stirring in one direction. Turn off the heat and add the green onions and sesame oil.
de: A 15-minute takeout favorite. Serve with fried rice or potstickers.

i: 1 bag (20 oz) frozen pork or chicken wontons
d:
Simmer the broth, soy sauce, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.

Add the wontons and cook per the package, about 5 minutes. Add the bok choy and carrots for the last 2 minutes.

Finish with green onions and sesame oil.
de: Frozen wontons and bok choy in a gingery broth.

i: 1 lb frozen mini meatballs or 1 lb ground beef and pork mix
3/4 cup acini di pepe or ditalini pasta
d:
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in oil for 6 minutes.

Add the broth and bring to a boil. Add the meatballs and pasta and simmer 10 minutes.

Stir in the spinach and parmesan.
de: Mini meatballs, tiny pasta and spinach in chicken broth.

n: White Bean, Sausage and Kale Soup
i: 1 lb mild Italian sausage or chicken sausage
d:
Brown the sausage with the onion and carrots.

Add the garlic, broth, beans and Italian seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes.

Mash a few beans against the pot to thicken it. Add the kale and simmer 5 minutes. Top with parmesan.
de: A hearty Tuscan-style soup with no tomatoes.

d:
Brown the sausage with the onion. Add the garlic.

Add the broth and Italian seasoning and bring to a boil. Add the noodles and cook 10-12 minutes.

Stir in the cream, mozzarella, parmesan and spinach. Serve with a spoonful of ricotta on each bowl.
de: Lasagna in soup form with a creamy ricotta-parmesan broth instead of tomato.

i: 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cut small
d:
Brown the beef in oil in batches. Add the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms and cook 5 minutes.

Add the broth, barley, thyme and Worcestershire.

Simmer covered for 45 minutes, until the barley and beef are tender. Season with salt and pepper.
de: Cozy and filling. Most of the time is hands-off simmering.

d:
Cook the bacon until crisp and set it aside. Cook the onion in the drippings for 4 minutes, then add the garlic.

Add the cauliflower and broth and simmer 15 minutes. Blend until mostly smooth.

Stir in the milk and cheese. Top with sour cream, bacon and green onions.
de: Tastes like loaded baked potato soup but is lighter.

i: 1 bag (30 oz) frozen diced hash brown potatoes
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Add the hash browns, broth, onion and cream of chicken soup to the slow cooker. Cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours.

Stir in the cream cheese until melted.

Top with cheddar, bacon and green onions.
de: A dump-and-go soup made with frozen hash browns.

d:
Melt the butter and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the broth and Alfredo and bring to a simmer.

Add the tortellini and broccoli and cook 6 minutes.

Stir in the chicken and parmesan.
de: Creamy Alfredo soup with tortellini and broccoli.

d:
Melt the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth.

Add the Worcestershire, nutmeg and meatballs and simmer 10 minutes. Add the noodles and cook 7 minutes.

Turn off the heat and stir in the sour cream and parsley.
de: Frozen meatballs and egg noodles in a creamy beef broth.

i: shredded Monterey Jack cheese and sour cream for topping
d:
Brown the turkey with the onion. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano.

Add the salsa verde, broth, beans and chiles. Simmer 20 minutes.

Top with cheese and sour cream.
de: A lean, mild green chili with ground turkey and white beans.

n: Chicken Caesar Salad with Garlic Croutons
d:
Season the chicken with salt, pepper and oil. Cook in a skillet 5-6 minutes per side, rest, and slice.

Toss the bread with butter and garlic powder. Bake at 400°F for 8-10 minutes until golden.

Toss the romaine with dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and parmesan.
de: Crisp romaine, parmesan, homemade croutons and grilled chicken.

d:
Warm the chicken with the BBQ sauce.

Arrange the romaine with corn, beans, cheese and tomatoes.

Top with BBQ chicken, drizzle with ranch mixed with a spoonful of BBQ sauce, and add the fried onions.
de: Smoky BBQ chicken, corn, black beans and ranch over chopped romaine.

d:
Cook the pasta, rinse with cold water, and drain well.

Mix the ranch and sour cream. Toss everything together.

Chill 10 minutes or up to 2 days.
de: A cold pasta salad that holds up for lunches.

d:
Toss the coleslaw mix, romaine, chicken, edamame, carrots and oranges.

Add the dressing and toss again.

Top with wonton strips and almonds just before serving.
de: Cabbage, carrots, edamame and crunchy wonton strips with sesame dressing.

d:
Brown the beef, drain, and simmer with taco seasoning and water for 5 minutes.

Mix the sour cream and ranch for a creamy dressing.

Pile the lettuce with beef, beans, cheese, avocado, tomatoes and chips, then drizzle with dressing.
de: Seasoned beef over lettuce with cheese, beans and crushed tortilla chips.

d:
Cook the orzo, rinse with cold water, and drain.

Whisk the oil, lemon juice, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.

Toss everything together. It tastes even better after an hour in the fridge.
de: Orzo, cucumber, feta and chicken in a lemon-oregano vinaigrette.

i: 1/2 cup ranch or blue cheese dressing
d:
Cook the tenders in oil 3-4 minutes per side, then toss them in buffalo sauce. Keep some plain for the kids.

Arrange the romaine, celery and carrots.

Top with chicken and cheese and drizzle with dressing.
de: Crispy buffalo chicken over greens with celery, carrots and blue cheese or ranch.

i: 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese or shredded cheddar cheese
d:
Toss the potatoes with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 425°F for 25 minutes.

Season the steak and sear in a hot skillet 4-5 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice thin.

Top the greens with potatoes, steak, tomatoes, cheese, dressing and fried onions.
de: Seared steak, crispy roasted potatoes and greens with a creamy dressing.

d:
Cook the quinoa per the package and cool slightly.

Whisk the oil, lime juice, cumin and salt.

Toss everything together.
de: Protein-packed quinoa with black beans, corn and a lime-cumin dressing.

d:
Season the chicken and cook in oil 5-6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.

Arrange the spinach, strawberries, pecans and feta.

Top with chicken and drizzle with dressing.
de: Spinach, strawberries, chicken, pecans and poppyseed dressing.

d:
Cook the pasta, rinse with cold water, and drain.

Toss with everything else.

Chill until serving.
de: Tri-color rotini with salami, mozzarella pearls and Italian dressing.

d:
Mix the chicken, yogurt, mayo, apple, celery, cranberries and pecans. Season with salt and pepper.

Spoon into lettuce cups.
de: Crunchy, light and no cooking.

d:
Season the chicken and cook 5-6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.

Whisk the oil, vinegar, maple syrup and Dijon.

Toss the greens with apples, cranberries, pecans and goat cheese. Top with chicken and dressing.
de: Fall salad with apples, cranberries, goat cheese and maple vinaigrette.

i: 1 bag (24 oz) frozen breaded chicken tenders
d:
Bake the tenders per the package and slice.

Arrange the romaine with cheese, eggs, tomatoes and bacon.

Top with tenders and serve with honey mustard.
de: Restaurant-style salad with crispy tenders and honey mustard.

i: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
d:
Cook the rice. Steam the broccoli.

Cook the chicken in oil 6-7 minutes until browned.

Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, vinegar, garlic, ginger, cornstarch and 1/4 cup water. Add to the pan and simmer 2 minutes until glossy. Serve over rice with broccoli and sesame seeds.
de: Sticky homemade teriyaki chicken with steamed broccoli over rice.

i: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and warmed
d:
Cook the rice and stir in the lime juice and cilantro.

Rub the chicken with oil and taco seasoning. Cook 5-6 minutes per side, rest, and dice.

Build bowls with rice, chicken, beans, corn, cheese, avocado and sour cream.
de: Cilantro-lime rice, seasoned chicken, beans, corn and toppings.

i: 1 fresh pineapple, cut into spears, or 1 can pineapple rings
d:
Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, garlic and ginger. Reserve 1/2 cup. Marinate the chicken in the rest for at least 15 minutes.

Cook the rice. Grill the chicken 5-6 minutes per side, basting with the reserved sauce. Grill the pineapple 2 minutes per side.

Slice and serve over rice with pineapple and green onions.
de: Hawaiian-style sweet and savory grilled chicken with pineapple and rice.

i: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
d:
Cook the rice and steam the vegetables.

Brown the chicken in butter for 6-7 minutes. Add the garlic.

Whisk the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch and 2 tbsp water. Add to the pan and simmer until thick. Serve over rice.
de: Sweet and savory sauce kids love, all in one skillet.

i: 1 tbsp oyster sauce or extra soy sauce
d:
Cook the chicken in 1 tbsp oil until done and set it aside. Scramble the eggs and set them aside.

Add the remaining oil and cook the onion, peas and carrots for 3 minutes. Add the garlic.

Add the rice and fry 3-4 minutes. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken and eggs. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.
de: Faster and better than takeout. Use day-old rice.

d:
Cook the rice. Toss the chicken with cornstarch, salt and pepper.

Cook the chicken in oil until golden, 5-6 minutes. Add the pepper, snap peas and garlic for 2 minutes.

Whisk the soy sauce, hoisin, honey, vinegar and 1/4 cup water. Add to the pan and simmer until thick. Stir in the cashews and serve over rice.
de: Tender chicken and toasted cashews in a savory brown sauce.

i: 1 can (20 oz) pineapple chunks, juice reserved
d:
Cook the rice. Toss the chicken in cornstarch, dip it in egg, and pan-fry in oil until golden. Transfer to a baking dish.

Simmer the sugar, vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce and 1/2 cup pineapple juice for 3 minutes.

Add the peppers and pineapple to the chicken, pour the sauce over, and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Serve over rice.
de: Crispy baked chicken in a sweet and sour sauce with pineapple and peppers.

i: 1 1/2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
d:
Cook the rice. Toss the beef in cornstarch.

Fry the beef in oil in batches until crisp, 2-3 minutes. Remove.

Cook the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add the soy sauce, brown sugar and water and simmer 5 minutes. Return the beef, add the green onions, and toss. Serve over rice.
de: Crispy flank steak in a sweet soy-garlic glaze.

d:
Brown the chicken and onion in butter for 5 minutes.

Add the rice, broth and garlic powder. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 15 minutes.

Add the broccoli on top, cover, and cook 5 minutes more. Stir in the cheddar and milk until creamy.
de: A one-pan comfort meal kids ask for again.

d:
Cook the rice. Toss the chicken with oil, spices, half the lemon juice and salt. Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes and slice.

Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with salt and a squeeze of lemon.

Mix the yogurt with garlic and lemon. Build bowls.
de: Spiced chicken, rice, cucumber-tomato salad and garlic sauce.

n: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken and Rice
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Season the chicken and sear it in an oven-safe skillet 3 minutes per side. Remove.

Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Stir in the rice, broth, lemon, oregano and thyme.

Nestle the chicken on top, cover, and bake 25 minutes. Dot with butter.
de: Seared chicken thighs baked on lemony rice.

d:
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.

Toss the chicken in cornstarch and pan-fry in oil until crisp.

Simmer the soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, vinegar, sesame oil and garlic for 2 minutes. Toss with the chicken and sesame seeds.
de: Crispy chicken bites in a sweet sesame glaze.

i: 3 lb pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
1 cup pico de gallo or corn salsa
d:
Rub the pork with cumin, oregano and salt. Add it to the slow cooker with the onion, garlic and citrus juices. Cook on low 8 hours.

Shred the pork, spread it on a sheet pan with some juices, and broil 4-5 minutes until crispy.

Serve over rice with beans, cheese and salsa.
de: Slow cooker carnitas, crisped under the broiler and served over rice.

d:
Cook the rice. Brown the chicken and onion in oil for 6 minutes.

Add the garlic, curry powder and ginger for 1 minute.

Add the coconut milk, broth and honey and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the spinach and serve over rice.
de: A creamy, mild yellow curry with coconut milk. Good for kids new to curry.

i: 1/2 lb ground beef or ground pork
d:
Brown the sausage and ground meat. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 5 minutes.

Add the garlic, Cajun seasoning and rice and stir for 1 minute.

Add the broth, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 18 minutes. Fluff and add the green onions.
de: Smoked sausage and rice with the Cajun trinity. Mild, with no tomatoes.

n: Ground Turkey and Zucchini Rice Skillet
d:
Brown the turkey in oil. Add the zucchini, pepper, garlic and Italian seasoning and cook 5 minutes.

Stir in the rice and parmesan.

Top with mozzarella, cover until melted, and season with salt and pepper.
de: A lean, veggie-heavy skillet with a light garlic-parmesan finish.

d:
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil and set them aside.

Brown the ham and pineapple in the remaining oil. Add the peas and carrots.

Add the rice and fry 4 minutes. Add the soy sauce, eggs, sesame oil and green onions.
de: Hawaiian fried rice. Good for leftover ham.

i: 12 oz lo mein noodles or spaghetti
2 tbsp oyster sauce or hoisin sauce
d:
Cook the noodles and drain.

Stir-fry the chicken in oil until cooked. Add the vegetables and garlic and cook 3 minutes.

Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
de: Takeout-style noodles with chicken and vegetables.

d:
Cook the chicken in 1 tbsp oil and set it aside. Scramble the eggs and set them aside.

Cook the peas, carrots and garlic in the remaining oil for 2 minutes. Add the cauliflower and cook 5-6 minutes until dry and tender.

Add the soy sauce, chicken, eggs, sesame oil and green onions.
de: Low-carb fried rice made with riced cauliflower.

d:
Cook the rice. Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil and remove it.

Stir-fry the vegetables in the remaining oil for 4 minutes. Add the garlic.

Whisk the soy sauce, honey, ginger, cornstarch and 1/3 cup water. Add with the chicken and simmer 1 minute until glossy.
de: A light, colorful stir fry with a simple soy-ginger sauce.

d:
Cook the pasta. Season the chicken and cook in oil 5-6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.

Melt the butter and cook the garlic for 1 minute. Add the cream and simmer 4 minutes.

Whisk in the parmesan until smooth. Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water, then top with chicken and parsley.
de: Homemade Alfredo in the time it takes to boil the pasta.

d:
Cook the pasta. Season the chicken and brown it in oil for 6-7 minutes.

Add the butter and garlic for 1 minute, then the broth and half and half. Simmer 3 minutes.

Stir in the parmesan and Italian seasoning, then the pasta.
de: Bite-size chicken in a light garlic-butter parmesan sauce.

i: 2 cups chopped frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the noodles and lay them flat.

Mix the ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, parmesan, egg, spinach, chicken and garlic powder.

Spread 1/2 cup Alfredo in a 9x13. Spread filling on each noodle, roll up, and place seam-side down. Top with the remaining Alfredo and mozzarella. Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover for 10.
de: Lasagna noodles rolled with ricotta and spinach and baked in Alfredo.

d:
Cook the spaghetti, adding the peas for the last minute. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.

Cook the bacon until crisp. Cook the chicken in the drippings with the garlic.

Whisk the eggs and parmesan. Off the heat, toss the hot pasta with bacon, chicken and the egg mixture, adding pasta water until creamy.
de: Silky egg-and-parmesan sauce with bacon and chicken. No cream needed.

d:
Cook the pasta. Brown the chicken in oil and remove it.

Brown the mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme.

Add the broth and cream and simmer 4 minutes. Stir in the parmesan, chicken and pasta.
de: Golden mushrooms and chicken in a garlic cream sauce.

d:
Cook the pasta. Cook the bacon until crisp and remove it.

Cook the chicken in the drippings with half the ranch seasoning.

Add the milk, cream cheese and the rest of the ranch and stir until smooth. Stir in the cheddar, pasta and bacon.
de: Creamy ranch pasta with bacon and cheddar.

d:
Cook the macaroni and drain.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer until thickened, 4 minutes.

Off the heat, stir in the cheeses, mustard and garlic powder. Season with salt, then fold in the pasta.
de: Creamy homemade mac. Add ham, hot dogs or broccoli if you like.

d:
Cook the tortellini and drain.

Warm the pesto and cream in the pot. Add the chicken and spinach until wilted.

Toss in the tortellini and parmesan.
de: Cheese tortellini tossed with pesto cream, chicken and spinach.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the penne, adding the broccoli for the last 2 minutes. Drain.

Mix with the chicken, Alfredo, milk, garlic powder and 1 cup mozzarella. Spread in a 9x13.

Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan and bake 20-25 minutes.
de: A baked penne Alfredo with chicken and broccoli under a mozzarella crust.

d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the noodles.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the broth and milk. Simmer until thick and add the garlic powder, Italian seasoning and 1/2 cup parmesan. Mix the ricotta and egg.

Layer in a 9x13: sauce, noodles, ricotta, chicken, spinach, mozzarella. Repeat 3 times and finish with sauce and cheese. Cover and bake 40 minutes, then uncover for 10. Rest 10 minutes.
de: A creamy white lasagna with chicken, spinach and three cheeses.

d:
Cook the noodles and toss with 1 tbsp butter. Heat the meatballs per the package.

Melt the remaining butter, whisk in the flour, then the broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and nutmeg. Simmer 5 minutes.

Stir in the sour cream and meatballs. Serve over the noodles.
de: Frozen meatballs in a creamy beef gravy over buttered noodles.

d:
Brown the beef with the seasonings and drain.

Add the broth, milk and macaroni. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring often.

Stir in the cheddar until melted.
de: The boxed classic, made from scratch in one pot.

d:
Cook the pasta. Brown the chicken in oil and remove it.

Cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute. Add the cream, broth and Italian seasoning and simmer 4 minutes.

Stir in the parmesan, spinach, chicken and pasta.
de: Sun-dried tomato cream sauce with spinach and parmesan. It's creamy, not red.

d:
Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.

Brown the sausage in oil. Add the garlic for 1 minute.

Add the pasta, broccoli, butter, parmesan and pasta water as needed. Toss until glossy.
de: Italian sausage, broccoli, garlic and parmesan with no sauce needed.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the spaghetti.

Cook the mushrooms and onion in butter for 6 minutes. Stir in the flour, then the broth and milk, and simmer until thick.

Mix with the pasta, chicken, peas and 3/4 cup parmesan. Spread in a 9x13, top with panko and the remaining parmesan, and bake 25 minutes.
de: Spaghetti, chicken and mushrooms baked in a creamy sauce.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the ziti 2 minutes short of the package time. Brown the sausage.

Mix the pasta, sausage, Alfredo, milk, Italian seasoning and 1 cup mozzarella.

Layer half in a 9x13, dollop with ricotta, add the rest, and top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan. Bake 25 minutes.
de: Baked ziti made with Alfredo, ricotta and Italian sausage.

i: 1 box (10 oz) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the shells and drain.

Mix the ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, parmesan, egg, spinach and garlic powder. Stuff the shells.

Spread half the Alfredo in a 9x13, add the shells, and top with the remaining sauce and mozzarella. Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover for 5.
de: Jumbo shells stuffed with three cheeses and baked in garlic Alfredo.

n: Garlic Butter Steak Bites and Pasta
i: 1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
d:
Cook the pasta. Season the steak and sear in oil over high heat 2-3 minutes in batches.

Lower the heat and add the butter and garlic for 1 minute. Add the cream and parmesan.

Toss with the pasta and steak and add the parsley.
de: Seared steak bites tossed with pasta in garlic butter and parmesan.

i: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, toasted in butter
d:
Cook the pasta.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk. Simmer until thick and stir in the Dijon and Swiss.

Add the chicken, ham and pasta. Top with toasted panko.
de: Chicken, ham and Swiss in a creamy Dijon sauce with crispy panko.

d:
Cook the pasta. Sauté the pepper and onion in oil for 6 minutes. Add the beef and garlic and cook until browned.

Add the cream, broth and Worcestershire and simmer 4 minutes.

Stir in the provolone until melted, then the pasta.
de: Shaved steak, peppers and onions in a provolone cream sauce.

i: 3/4 cup Marsala wine or chicken broth
d:
Cook the pasta. Dredge the chicken in seasoned flour and cook in oil 3-4 minutes per side. Remove.

Brown the mushrooms. Add the garlic, Marsala and broth and simmer 5 minutes.

Add the cream and butter, return the chicken, and serve over the pasta.
de: Restaurant-style creamy mushroom Marsala sauce over linguine.

d:
Cook the pasta. Dredge the chicken in seasoned flour and cook in oil 3-4 minutes per side. Remove.

Melt the butter with the garlic. Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer 4 minutes.

Toss with the pasta and parmesan and top with sliced chicken. Add capers for the adults.
de: Bright lemon-butter sauce over angel hair. Capers are optional.

i: 1 box (16 oz) frozen potato and cheese pierogies
d:
Boil the pierogies 3 minutes and drain.

Brown the kielbasa and onion in 1 tbsp butter for 6 minutes. Push to the side.

Add the remaining butter and pierogies and brown 2-3 minutes per side. Serve with sour cream and green onions.
de: Frozen pierogies and smoked sausage browned with onions in butter.

n: Garlic Butter Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, panko, egg, parmesan and seasonings. Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls and bake 15-18 minutes.

Cook the spaghetti if using.

Melt the butter with the garlic. Toss the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes, then add the meatballs and pasta.
de: Baked turkey meatballs over zoodles and pasta in garlic butter.

n: Cheesy Chicken Bacon Ranch Tater Tot Casserole
i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the chicken, bacon, soup, sour cream, ranch and 1 cup cheddar. Spread in a 9x13.

Top with tater tots in a single layer.

Bake 35 minutes. Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and bake 5 minutes more.
de: Ranch chicken and bacon under a crispy tater tot top.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the chicken, soup, sour cream and half the poppy seeds. Spread in an 8x8 or 9x13.

Toss the crackers with butter and the remaining poppy seeds and sprinkle on top.

Bake 30 minutes. Serve over rice.
de: Creamy chicken under a buttery Ritz cracker topping.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the onion and pepper in butter for 5 minutes.

Stir in the soups, chiles, sour cream, cumin, chili powder and chicken.

Layer tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese in a 9x13 three times. Bake 30 minutes.
de: The Texas classic made with green chiles instead of Rotel.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Steam the broccoli 3 minutes and lay it in a 9x13 with the chicken.

Mix the soup, yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, curry powder and 1 cup cheddar. Spread it over the top.

Top with the remaining cheese and panko tossed in butter. Bake 30 minutes.
de: Chicken and broccoli in a lightened cheddar sauce.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the spaghetti.

Melt the soup, Velveeta, broth, milk and garlic powder in the pot. Add the chicken, chiles and pasta.

Spread in a 9x13, top with cheddar, and bake 20 minutes.
de: Creamy chicken spaghetti with Velveeta and no Rotel.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Simmer the soup, broth, milk and seasonings in an oven-safe skillet. Add the chicken and vegetables.

Quarter the biscuits and arrange them on top.

Bake 20-25 minutes until golden.
de: Creamy chicken and vegetables baked under fluffy biscuits.

i: 1 bag (30 oz) frozen shredded hash browns, thawed
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the hash browns, ham, soup, sour cream, 1 1/2 cups cheddar, onion and 2 tbsp butter. Spread in a 9x13.

Top with the remaining cheese and cornflakes tossed in butter.

Bake 45 minutes.
de: Cheesy hash brown casserole loaded with ham.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the chicken, green beans, soup and sour cream in a 9x13.

Stir the stuffing mix with the broth and butter.

Spoon over the top and bake 30 minutes.
de: A Thanksgiving-flavored weeknight bake with green beans.

i: 1 bag (9 oz) nacho cheese Doritos, crushed
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Brown the beef with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water. Stir in the beans, queso and sour cream.

Layer half the Doritos, the beef mixture and the cheese in a 9x13. Top with more Doritos.

Bake 20 minutes. Top with lettuce.
de: Taco beef, queso and crushed Doritos baked together.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the noodles. Brown the beef with garlic powder and stir in the soup.

Mix the cream cheese, sour cream and green onions with the noodles.

Layer the noodles and beef in a 9x13, top with cheddar, and bake 25 minutes.
de: Ground beef and egg noodles in a sour cream and cream cheese layer.

i: 2 boxes (16 oz) frozen potato and cheese pierogies
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Brown the kielbasa and onion in butter.

Whisk the sour cream with the broth. Layer the frozen pierogies, kielbasa and sauce in a 9x13.

Cover and bake 25 minutes. Top with cheese and bacon and bake 10 minutes more.
de: Frozen pierogies baked with kielbasa, cheddar and a sour cream sauce.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Brown the steak, pepper and onion in oil. Season with salt and pepper.

Mix with the soup, milk and biscuit pieces and spread in a 9x13.

Bake 25 minutes, top with provolone, and bake 5 minutes more.
de: Biscuit pieces baked with steak, peppers and provolone.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the rice.

Mix the rice, broccoli, chicken, soup, sour cream, milk and 2 cups cheddar. Spread in a 9x13.

Top with the remaining cheese and crackers tossed in butter. Bake 30 minutes.
de: The classic baked rice casserole kids love.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Whisk the soups and broth and stir in the rice. Pour into a greased 9x13.

Lay the chicken on top and sprinkle with onion soup mix and paprika.

Cover tightly with foil and bake 75 minutes. Don't peek.
de: Dump-and-bake chicken and rice. Ten minutes of work, then the oven does the rest.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Season and sear the chops 2 minutes per side.

Whisk the soup, milk and garlic powder. Layer the potatoes, onion, sauce and cheese in a 9x13.

Top with the chops, cover, and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more.
de: Seared pork chops baked over creamy sliced potatoes.

i: 1 bag (30 oz) frozen shredded hash browns, thawed
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the hash browns, ham, soup, sour cream, cheddar and 4 tbsp butter.

Spread in a 9x13 and top with cornflakes tossed in the remaining butter.

Bake 40-45 minutes.
de: Cheesy potato casserole with a crispy cornflake top. Ham makes it a meal.

i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Lay the chicken in a greased 9x13 and top each piece with Swiss.

Whisk the soup and milk and pour it over the top.

Sprinkle with stuffing and drizzle with butter. Cover and bake 30 minutes, then uncover for 10.
de: Chicken breasts baked under Swiss cheese, cream sauce and buttery stuffing.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the tortellini 2 minutes short. Brown the sausage with the garlic.

Stir in the cream, cream cheese and parmesan until smooth. Add the spinach and tortellini.

Pour into a baking dish, top with mozzarella, and bake 20 minutes.
de: Tortellini, sausage and spinach baked in a creamy white sauce.

d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Scoop out the zucchini centers, chop them, and mix with the chicken, Alfredo and Italian seasoning.

Fill the boats and top with mozzarella and parmesan.

Bake 20-25 minutes.
de: Zucchini halves stuffed with Alfredo chicken and mozzarella.

i: sour cream and salsa verde for dipping
d:
Toss the chicken with the taco seasoning.

Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and chicken and fold.

Cook in a buttered skillet 2-3 minutes per side. Cut into wedges.
de: Crispy cheesy quesadillas. Good for leftover chicken.

i: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced into strips
sour cream, avocado and cheese for topping
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss everything except the tortillas and toppings with salt on a sheet pan.

Roast 20 minutes, then broil 2 minutes for char.

Squeeze lime over the top and serve in warm tortillas.
de: Chicken, peppers and onions roasted on one pan.

d:
Rub the chicken with oil and taco seasoning. Cook in a skillet 5-6 minutes per side and chop.

Mix the sour cream with lime zest and juice.

Fill the tortillas with chicken, cabbage, cheese, avocado and crema.
de: Seasoned chicken thighs in tortillas with a cool lime sour cream.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Brown the beef with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water.

Spread beans on each tortilla, add beef, rice and cheese, and roll. Place seam-side down in a 9x13.

Pour the queso over the top and bake 15 minutes.
de: Beef and bean burritos smothered in white queso and baked.

d:
Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the chicken with 1 cup cheese, roll it into the tortillas, and place them in a 9x13.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the broth. Simmer until thick. Off the heat, stir in the sour cream and chiles.

Pour over the enchiladas, top with the remaining cheese, and bake 20-25 minutes.
de: Chicken enchiladas in a sour cream and green chile white sauce.

i: 6 small flour tortillas or tostada shells
1 cup nacho cheese sauce or queso dip
d:
Brown the beef with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water.

In the center of each large tortilla, layer beef, queso, a tostada shell, sour cream, lettuce and cheese. Cover with a small tortilla.

Fold the edges up and over. Toast seam-side down in a skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
de: The Taco Bell favorite: beef, queso, a crunchy tostada and cool toppings folded and toasted.

i: 3 lb pork shoulder, cut into chunks
diced onion, cilantro and lime wedges for serving
d:
Rub the pork with the spices. Cook on low 8 hours with the onion, garlic and citrus juices.

Shred, spread on a sheet pan with a little juice, and broil 5 minutes until crispy.

Serve in warm tortillas with onion, cilantro and lime.
de: Tender orange-lime pork crisped under the broiler.

d:
Warm the beans with the cumin and garlic powder. Stir in the rice.

Fill the tortillas with the bean mixture and cheese, and roll.

Toast seam-side down in a skillet until golden.
de: A budget meatless night. They freeze well.

i: guacamole and sour cream for serving
d:
Toss the steak with 2 tbsp oil, lime juice and spices. Rest 15 minutes.

Cook the peppers and onion on the griddle with the remaining oil for 6-8 minutes.

Sear the steak 3-4 minutes per side, rest, and slice thin. Serve in tortillas.
de: Marinated skirt steak seared on the griddle with peppers and onions.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Season the chicken with taco seasoning and lay it in a baking dish.

Pour the queso and chiles over the top and sprinkle with cheese.

Bake 25-30 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Serve with rice and beans.
de: Chicken breasts baked under white queso, green chiles and cheese.

d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Brown the beef with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water.

Layer half the chips, beef, beans and cheese on a sheet pan. Repeat.

Bake 8-10 minutes. Drizzle with warm queso and top with avocado, sour cream and lettuce.
de: Loaded nachos for dinner, built so every chip gets toppings.

i: warm tortillas or rice for serving
d:
Season the pork with salt, cumin and oregano.

Add everything to the slow cooker. Cook on low 6-8 hours.

Shred lightly and serve in tortillas or over rice.
de: Slow-cooked pork in tangy salsa verde for tacos, burritos or rice.

i: 1 cup corn salsa or pico de gallo
d:
Brown the turkey with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water.

Spoon into lettuce cups.

Top with avocado, salsa, cheese and a spoonful of yogurt.
de: Light, crunchy tacos in butter lettuce cups.

i: sour cream and guacamole for dipping
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the chicken, cream cheese, Jack cheese, salsa verde and cumin.

Roll 3 tbsp filling tightly in each tortilla. Place seam-side down on a sheet pan and spray with oil.

Bake 15-18 minutes until crisp.
de: Rolled crispy tortillas filled with chicken and cream cheese.

i: shredded lettuce, sour cream and avocado for topping
d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Brown the meat with taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water.

Spread beans on the tostadas and top with meat and cheese.

Bake 6-8 minutes and finish with toppings.
de: Crispy tostadas spread with beans and topped like a pizza.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Mix the queso, sour cream, chiles and cumin. Toss half with the chicken, beans and corn.

Layer tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese in a 9x13 three times. Spread the remaining sauce on top with more cheese.

Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover for 5.
de: Layers of tortillas, chicken, beans and a queso-sour cream sauce.

d:
Bake the bacon on a sheet pan at 400°F for 15-18 minutes.

Whisk the dry ingredients. Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and butter, then stir into the dry ingredients just until combined.

Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, then flip. Serve with syrup and bacon.
de: Fluffy from-scratch pancakes for breakfast-for-dinner night.

i: 1 bag (24 oz) frozen breaded chicken tenders
d:
Bake the tenders per the package.

Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Whisk in the milk, eggs and butter.

Cook in a waffle iron. Top with chicken and syrup.
de: Crispy chicken tenders on Belgian waffles with hot honey or syrup.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F and grease a sheet pan.

Whisk the pancake mix, milk, eggs and butter. Spread on the pan and sprinkle with toppings in sections.

Bake 12-15 minutes. Cook the sausage alongside. Cut into squares.
de: One big pancake, cut into squares. No flipping.

i: 8 thick slices brioche or Texas toast
d:
Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla and cinnamon.

Dip the bread and cook on a buttered griddle 2-3 minutes per side.

Serve with berries and syrup.
de: Custardy cinnamon French toast with berries.

d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Cook the onion and broccoli in butter in an oven-safe skillet for 4 minutes. Add the ham.

Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour into the skillet and sprinkle with cheese.

Cook 2 minutes on the stove, then bake 12-15 minutes until set.
de: A one-pan egg dinner. Good for leftover veggies.

i: 1 1/2 lb Yukon gold potatoes, diced small
d:
Microwave the potatoes 5 minutes to par-cook.

Brown the sausage and remove it. Crisp the potatoes in oil for 8-10 minutes, adding the pepper and onion.

Return the sausage. Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 4-5 minutes. Top with cheese.
de: Crispy potatoes, sausage and peppers topped with fried eggs.

i: salsa verde or sour cream for dipping
d:
Scramble the eggs with salt and pepper.

Fill the tortillas with eggs, bacon and cheese.

Cook in a buttered skillet 2 minutes per side.
de: Scrambled eggs, bacon and cheese in crispy tortillas.

d:
Add the chicken, cream cheese, ranch and broth to the slow cooker. Cook on low 4-6 hours.

Shred the chicken and stir in the bacon and cheddar.

Serve on buns.
de: Creamy ranch-bacon chicken for sandwiches, wraps or over rice.

d:
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic and basil. Pour over the chicken in the slow cooker. Cook on low 4 hours.

Remove the chicken. Whisk the cornstarch with 2 tbsp water, stir it into the sauce, and cook on high 10 minutes.

Shred or slice the chicken and toss in the sauce. Serve over rice with broccoli.
de: Sticky honey-garlic chicken thighs over rice.

i: 2 cans (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Add everything except the biscuits to the slow cooker. Cook on low 6 hours.

Shred the chicken in the pot.

Tear the biscuits into pieces and drop them on top. Cook on high 45-60 minutes until fluffy.
de: Creamy chicken stew with biscuit dumplings.

d:
Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg and half the onion soup mix. Form 6 patties and brown them 2 minutes per side.

Whisk the gravy mixes, the rest of the onion soup mix and the water. Layer the patties, mushrooms and gravy in the slow cooker.

Cook on low 6 hours. Serve over mashed potatoes.
de: Frozen-patty or homemade Salisbury steak in onion gravy. Serve over mashed potatoes.

n: Slow Cooker Salsa Verde Chicken Tacos
i: shredded cheese, sour cream and avocado for topping
d:
Add the chicken, salsa verde and taco seasoning to the slow cooker. Cook on low 4-6 hours.

Shred in the juices.

Serve in tortillas with toppings.
de: Three ingredients, shredded and ready for tacos, nachos or bowls.

d:
Add the macaroni, water, butter, salt and mustard to the Instant Pot. Cook on high pressure 4 minutes, then quick release.

Stir in the milk and cheeses until creamy.

Season and serve.
de: Creamy mac and cheese in about 15 minutes.

i: 2 cups long grain white rice, rinsed
d:
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic powder and salt. Sear in oil on Sauté and remove.

Cook the onion and garlic. Add the rice and broth and lay the chicken on top.

Cook on high pressure 10 minutes with a 10-minute natural release. Stir in the peas.
de: Seasoned chicken and fluffy rice done together.

n: Slow Cooker Pork Chops and Gravy
i: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
d:
Lay the chops in the slow cooker.

Whisk the soup, gravy mix, ranch and broth and pour it over the chops.

Cook on low 6 hours. Serve with mashed potatoes.
de: Fork-tender pork chops in creamy gravy over mashed potatoes.

d:
Add the chicken, broth, Italian seasoning, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes to the slow cooker. Cook on low 4 hours.

Stir in the cream, parmesan and spinach and cook 15 minutes more.

Serve over pasta or rice.
de: Chicken in a garlic parmesan cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes and spinach.

d:
Add the potatoes, onion and broth to the slow cooker. Top with kielbasa and green beans.

Drizzle with butter mixed with the seasonings.

Cook on low 6 hours.
de: Smoked sausage, baby potatoes and green beans in garlic butter.

i: 1 1/2 lb flank steak or chuck, thinly sliced
d:
Brown the beef in oil on Sauté. Add the garlic, broth, soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil.

Cook on high pressure 10 minutes, then quick release.

Stir in cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water on Sauté. Add the steamed broccoli and serve over rice.
de: Tender beef in a savory sauce with bright broccoli.

d:
Add the chicken to the slow cooker. Whisk the remaining ingredients except the buns and slaw and pour over.

Cook on low 4-6 hours. Shred in the sauce.

Serve on buns with coleslaw.
de: Sweet and smoky shredded chicken for sliders.

n: Blackstone Hibachi Chicken and Fried Rice
d:
Mix the mayo, ketchup, sugar, garlic powder and 1 tbsp water for the yum yum sauce.

On the griddle, cook the vegetables in butter and soy sauce. Cook the chicken in butter, garlic and soy sauce.

Scramble the eggs, add the rice, butter and soy sauce, and fry 4 minutes. Serve everything with yum yum sauce.
de: Hibachi night at home with yum yum sauce.

d:
Whisk the oil, lemon, garlic and seasonings with salt. Toss with the chicken and marinate at least 15 minutes.

Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers.

Grill over medium-high heat 10-12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
de: Marinated chicken and veggie skewers on the grill.

d:
Season the chops with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

Simmer the honey, soy sauce, garlic and butter for 2 minutes.

Grill the chops 4-5 minutes per side, brushing with glaze at the end, until 145°F.
de: Juicy chops with a sticky honey garlic glaze.

d:
Toss the drumsticks with oil, brown sugar, spices and salt.

Grill over medium indirect heat for 30-35 minutes, turning occasionally.

Brush with BBQ sauce and grill 5 minutes more over direct heat until caramelized and 175°F.
de: Kid-friendly drumsticks with a sweet BBQ glaze.

d:
Toss the steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

Grill over high heat 3-4 minutes per side.

Toss with butter, garlic and parsley.
de: Sirloin tips grilled on skewers and tossed in garlic herb butter.

d:
Marinate the chicken in half the teriyaki for 15 minutes. Cook the rice.

Thread the chicken, pineapple, pepper and onion onto skewers.

Grill 10-12 minutes, brushing with the remaining teriyaki. Serve over rice.
de: Teriyaki chicken, pineapple and peppers on the grill.

d:
Toss the chicken with oil, lemon zest, half the juice, lemon pepper and garlic powder.

Grill 5-6 minutes per side until 165°F.

Brush with butter mixed with the remaining lemon juice.
de: Simple, bright grilled chicken that goes with any side.

n: Blackstone Garlic Butter Steak Bites and Potatoes
d:
Microwave the potatoes 5 minutes. Crisp them on the griddle in oil for 10 minutes.

Sear the steak on high 2-3 minutes.

Toss everything with butter, garlic, Italian seasoning and parsley.
de: Crispy potatoes and seared steak bites on the griddle.

n: Grilled Pork Tenderloin with Dry Rub
d:
Rub the pork with oil and the spice mix.

Grill over medium-high, turning every 4-5 minutes, for 18-22 minutes until 145°F.

Rest 5 minutes and slice.
de: A sweet-smoky rub on a quick-grilling cut.

i: 3 packs (5 oz) yakisoba noodles or ramen noodles
d:
Mix the soy sauce, Worcestershire, ketchup and brown sugar.

Cook the chicken in oil on the griddle. Add the vegetables for 4 minutes.

Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2-3 minutes.
de: Griddle noodles with chicken, cabbage and a sweet-savory sauce.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with oil and seasonings and roast 15 minutes.

Add the sausage and green beans and roast 15-20 minutes more.

Sprinkle with parmesan.
de: Smoked sausage, potatoes and green beans roasted on one pan.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.

Whisk the honey, mustards, garlic and thyme. Toss with the chicken in a baking dish.

Bake 30-35 minutes until 175°F, basting once.
de: Crispy-skinned thighs with a sweet honey mustard glaze.

d:
Mix the panko, parmesan and seasonings. Dip the chops in egg, then press into the crumbs.

Brown in oil 3 minutes per side.

Finish in a 400°F oven for 8-10 minutes until 145°F.
de: Crispy panko-parmesan crust and juicy chops.

n: Homemade Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the crumbs, parmesan and spices. Dip the tenders in egg, then in the crumbs.

Arrange on a rack over a sheet pan, spray with oil, and bake 15-18 minutes.

Whisk the honey, Dijon and mayo for dipping.
de: Crispy oven-fried tenders that beat the frozen ones.

d:
Mix the beef, panko, egg, Worcestershire and onion powder. Form 4 oval patties and brown 4 minutes per side. Remove.

Cook the mushrooms and onion in butter for 6 minutes. Stir in the flour, then the broth, and simmer until thick.

Return the patties, cover, and simmer 10 minutes.
de: Diner classic. Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

n: Garlic Butter Chicken Bites and Potatoes
d:
Microwave the potatoes 5 minutes, then brown in oil 8-10 minutes. Remove.

Season and brown the chicken 6-7 minutes.

Return the potatoes and add the butter, garlic and Italian seasoning. Toss for 1 minute and top with parmesan.
de: Skillet chicken and crispy baby potatoes in garlic butter.

d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Soak the panko in milk. Mix with the beef, eggs, onion, Worcestershire, garlic powder and salt.

Shape into a loaf on a lined sheet pan.

Bake 40 minutes. Brush with BBQ sauce mixed with brown sugar and bake 15 minutes more, until 160°F. Rest 10 minutes.
de: Tender meatloaf with a BBQ glaze instead of the usual ketchup.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the sweet potato with 1 tbsp oil for 10 minutes.

Add the chicken, broccoli and pepper tossed with the remaining oil and seasonings.

Roast 15-18 minutes more.
de: Chicken, broccoli, peppers and sweet potatoes on one pan.

d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the ranch and roast 15 minutes.

Add the chops and green beans. Brush with the remaining oil, butter and ranch.

Roast 18-20 minutes until the pork is 145°F.
de: A three-ingredient seasoning on a whole sheet pan dinner.

d:
Season the flour with garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Dip the steaks in flour, then egg mixed with 1/2 cup milk, then flour again.

Fry in oil 3-4 minutes per side. Drain.

Pour off all but 3 tbsp oil. Whisk in 3 tbsp of the flour, then 2 cups milk, and simmer until thick with lots of pepper.
de: Crispy cube steaks with peppery cream gravy.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the drumsticks dry.

Toss with oil, baking powder and spices. Arrange on a rack over a sheet pan.

Bake 40-45 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy and 175°F.
de: Seasoned drumsticks, crispy and kid-friendly with almost no work.

i: 1 box (16 oz) frozen potato and cheese pierogies
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F.

Toss everything with oil, garlic powder and salt on a sheet pan.

Roast 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway.
de: Frozen pierogies, sausage and peppers roasted on one pan.

d:
Dredge the chicken in seasoned flour and brown in oil 4 minutes per side. Remove.

Cook the onion in butter for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and 1 tbsp of the leftover flour.

Whisk in the broth, cream and thyme. Return the chicken and simmer 8 minutes.
de: Pan-seared chicken in a rich onion gravy over rice or mashed potatoes.

i: 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken or leftover chili
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and prick with a fork.

Bake 50-60 minutes until tender.

Split open and set out all the toppings.
de: Set out toppings and everyone builds their own. Good for leftover chili or chicken.

n: Lemon Garlic Chicken and Asparagus Skillet
d:
Season and brown the chicken in oil 6-7 minutes. Remove.

Cook the asparagus in butter 3-4 minutes. Add the garlic.

Return the chicken, add the lemon juice and parmesan, and toss.
de: A light one-skillet dinner ready in 25 minutes.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake 40-45 minutes, or microwave 10-12 minutes.

Warm the chicken with the BBQ sauce.

Split the potatoes, fill with chicken, and top with cheese, yogurt and green onions.
de: Roasted sweet potatoes topped with BBQ chicken and a little cheese.

d:
Mix the turkey, feta, spinach, oregano, garlic powder and salt. Form 4 patties.

Grill or pan-cook 5-6 minutes per side until 165°F.

Serve on buns with tzatziki and cucumber.
de: Juicy turkey burgers with feta and spinach, served with tzatziki.

n: Chicken Sausage and Veggie Sheet Pan
i: 12 oz fully cooked chicken sausage, sliced
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato, sprouts and onion with oil, garlic powder and salt. Roast 15 minutes.

Add the sausage and drizzle with maple syrup.

Roast 10-12 minutes more.
de: Chicken sausage, sweet potatoes and Brussels sprouts with a maple glaze.

d:
Heat the oven to 400°F. Lay the chicken in a baking dish and season with salt and pepper.

Spread with pesto and top with tomatoes and mozzarella.

Bake 22-25 minutes until 165°F.
de: Chicken breasts topped with pesto, tomatoes and mozzarella.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F.

Spread Alfredo on the flatbreads and top with chicken, spinach and cheeses.

Bake 8-10 minutes until bubbly.
de: Naan or flatbread topped with Alfredo, chicken, spinach and mozzarella.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the butter and garlic and spread it on the bread.

Dollop with ricotta and top with mozzarella, parmesan, pepperoni and Italian seasoning.

Bake 10-12 minutes until golden.
de: French bread with garlic butter, mozzarella and pepperoni. No red sauce.

i: 1 lb pizza dough or 1 prebaked pizza crust
d:
Heat the oven to 475°F. Stretch the dough on a sheet pan.

Spread with BBQ sauce and top with chicken, onion and cheeses.

Bake 12-15 minutes. Top with cilantro.
de: BBQ sauce base, chicken, red onion, mozzarella and gouda.

i: 1 lb pizza dough or 1 prebaked pizza crust
d:
Heat the oven to 475°F. Stretch the dough on a sheet pan.

Spread with ranch and top with chicken, bacon and cheeses.

Bake 12-15 minutes. Top with green onions.
de: Ranch base with chicken, bacon and cheddar-mozzarella.

i: pepperoni, cooked sausage or ham for topping
d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush the naan with oil mixed with garlic.

Top with cheeses and toppings.

Bake 8 minutes.
de: Fast personal pizzas the kids can top themselves.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll into circles.

Mix the cheeses, ham and Italian seasoning. Spoon onto half of each circle, fold, and crimp the edges.

Brush with egg, cut a small slit in each, and bake 15-18 minutes.
de: Pizza dough folded around ricotta, mozzarella and ham or pepperoni.

i: 2 cans (8 oz) refrigerated crescent dough sheets
d:
Heat the oven to 375°F. Unroll the dough sheets and top with pepperoni and mozzarella.

Roll up, slice into 1-inch rolls, and place in a greased 9-inch pan.

Brush with butter mixed with garlic powder and Italian seasoning, sprinkle with parmesan, and bake 18-20 minutes.
de: Crescent dough rolled with pepperoni and mozzarella, with garlic butter for dipping.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the butter, garlic and parsley and spread it on the bread.

Top with the cheeses.

Bake 10 minutes, then broil 1 minute.
de: Ready in 15 minutes and goes with every pasta night.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F.

Toss the broccoli with oil, garlic powder and salt and roast 15 minutes.

Add the parmesan and roast 3 minutes more. Squeeze lemon on top.
de: Crispy-edged broccoli that kids eat.

d:
Melt the butter and add the corn. Cook 5-6 minutes.

Stir in the honey and cream cheese until creamy.

Season with salt and pepper.
de: Sweet, buttery corn in 10 minutes.

d:
Boil the green beans 4 minutes and drain.

Cook the bacon until crisp. Add the garlic and butter.

Toss in the green beans for 2 minutes.
de: Garlicky green beans tossed with crispy bacon.

d:
Heat the oven to 425°F.

Toss the potatoes with oil and seasonings.

Roast 35 minutes, flipping once.
de: Golden roasted potatoes with garlic and herbs.

d:
Cook the rice in the water with butter and salt.

Fluff and stir in the lime and cilantro.
de: Chipotle-style rice for taco nights and bowls.

d:
Char the corn in butter in a hot skillet for 6-8 minutes.

Stir in the mayo, sour cream, lime and half the cotija.

Top with the remaining cotija and chili powder.
de: Elote-style corn with mayo, lime, cotija and chili powder.

d:
Whisk the sour cream, vinegar, sugar, dill and salt.

Toss with the cucumbers and onion.

Chill until serving.
de: A cool, crunchy side for grilled meats.

d:
Simmer the carrots in salted water for 8 minutes and drain.

Melt the butter and honey in the pan.

Toss the carrots with the glaze and thyme for 3 minutes.
de: Tender carrots in a buttery honey glaze.

d:
Combine the fruit.

Whisk the honey and lime juice and toss.
de: A bright side for breakfast-for-dinner or sandwich night.

d:
Toss the romaine with dressing.

Top with croutons and parmesan.
de: A crunchy side salad with store-bought shortcuts.

i: 3 lb Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
d:
Boil the potatoes and garlic in salted water for 15 minutes.

Drain and mash with the butter, milk and sour cream.

Season with salt and pepper.
de: Creamy mashed potatoes for Salisbury steak, smothered chicken and roasts.
